lateral_definition: camera box centre minus NGSIM centre (front centre moved back half the vehicle length along its heading), in the junction frame; lateral is dx when the reference's lane arm (else the camera lane's, else the nearer axis) is N or S, dy otherwise; D is numpy's linear-interpolation 90th percentile of |lateral| over all matched points, in or out of lanes

along_heading_vs_speed_moving.reading: slope is the time offset that would explain the along-heading error; intercept is a fixed offset along the heading

exploratory_rerun_at_best_shift.chosen_by: of the shifts tried, the one whose moving vehicles' median along-heading error is nearest zero, on these same data: exploration only, not a new time sync and not a gate result
